css: .sb-footer-classic { background: var(--sb-color-bg-alt, #f8f9fa); border-top: 1px solid var(--sb-color-border, #e2e8f0); padding: 28px 20px; margin-top: 40px; color: var(--sb-color-muted, #666); } .sb-footer-classic .sb-footer-inner { max-width: var(--sb-content-max-width, 920px); margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; align-items: center; text-align: center; } .sb-footer-classic .sb-menu { display: flex; gap: 20px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; } .sb-footer-classic .sb-menu a { color: var(--sb-color-muted, #666); font-size: 0.95em; } .sb-footer-classic .sb-menu a:hover { color: var(--sb-color-link); } .sb-footer-classic .sb-footer-copyright { font-size: 0.9em; }
